name: IBoundedZSet
doc: A bounded Z-set view with capacity limits and eviction triggers.

members.name: Capacity
members.doc: The maximum capacity of the Z-set.

members.name: IsSaturated
members.doc: Whether the capacity has been reached.

laws: Bounded Z-set admission preserves the inherited Z-set weight algebra for admitted entries.
Capacity pressure must be observable as explicit rejection or loss accounting; it may not silently drop signed weight.
A saturated bounded Z-set must report IsSaturated = true.
